# Beauty Affairs

> > Beauty Affairs is an Australian premium beauty retailer offering luxury skincare, makeup, and fragrance from brands like Guerlain, Juvena, Declare, Orogold, INIKA, and Dermalogica.

The online store specializes in anti-aging treatments, organic cosmetics, and professional-grade skincare with key ingredients like hyaluronic acid, peptides, royal jelly, and AHAs. Beauty Affairs ships via Australia Post and regularly features clearance deals on premium beauty products.

## Key Topics

- Luxury Skincare
- Anti-Aging Serums
- Guerlain Abeille Royale
- Orogold 24K Gold Treatments
- Declare Swiss Skincare
- Juvena Age-Defying
- INIKA Organic Makeup
- Dermalogica Professional Skincare
- Hyaluronic Acid
- Peptides (Palmitoyl Oligopeptide)
- Royal Jelly & Honey
- AHA Exfoliants
- Paraben-Free Formulas
- Mineral Foundation
- Clearance Beauty Deals
